description: Estimate WHEN an order would arrive at an Australian postcode — the question behind 'can I get it by Friday?'. Works the timeline through honestly: production starts only after the customer approves their digital proof (3pm AEST cutoff), then production time for that product, then transit for their postcode (metro/regional/remote bands). Returns an arrival WINDOW plus the assumptions it made. This is an ESTIMATE, never a guarantee — always relay the caveat, and for a hard deadline tell them to call 1300 721 614. Free pickup from Derrimut VIC is usually the fastest option.

artwork_ready.description: true if artwork is print-ready and the proof will be approved immediately

product.description: product name — used to read its real production time
